Help-center excerpts:

[referrals] Refer a friend (effective 2025-01-01)
When a friend opens a Tallowbrook account with your invite link and qualifies, you each get $25.00.

## How your friend qualifies

They need to receive at least $500 in direct deposits within 60 days of opening their account.

## When you're paid

Both bonuses are paid within 5 business days of your friend qualifying.

## Your invite link

Tap Profile, then Invite friends. Share the link any way you like. Your friend has to use the link when they sign up. We can't add a referral afterward.

## Rules

- Your friend must be new to

[referrals] Refer a friend (effective 2025-01-01)
add a referral afterward.

## Rules

- Your friend must be new to Tallowbrook.
- You can't refer yourself or open a second account.
- Referral bonuses may be reported to tax authorities.

## Didn't get your bonus?

Check your friend used your link and received the direct deposits in time. If they did, message support.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[savings-tax-forms] Tax forms for interest (effective 2025-01-01)
report it.

## Premium ATM surcharge refunds and bonuses

ATM surcharge refunds aren't interest and don't appear on the form. Referral bonuses may be reported separately.

## Tax questions

We can't give tax advice. For questions about how to report interest, talk to a tax professional.

## Wrong details on the form

If your name or taxpayer ID on the form is wrong, message support. Changes to your legal name or taxpayer ID go to our Verification team.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[savings-apy-basic-v2] Savings rate on Basic (effective 2026-06-01)
Earn more

Plus members earn 2.00% APY on the same balance.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[savings-apy-plus-v1] Savings rate on Plus (effective 2025-07-01)
Earn more

Premium members earn 4.10% APY on the same balance.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[savings-apy-plus-v2] Savings rate on Plus (effective 2026-06-01)
Earn more

Premium members earn 3.75% APY on the same balance.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[cushion-how-it-works] How Cushion works (effective 2025-01-01)
ATM withdrawals, transfers, BrookPay, wires or plan fees.

## What it costs

Nothing. Cushion has no fees ($0.00) and no interest.

## Paying it back

Your next deposit repays it automatically. If your balance stays negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended. See "Repaying Cushion".

## Turning it off

You can switch Cushion off at any time in the same place. Purchases larger than your balance are then declined, with no fee.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the

[cushion-plus] Cushion on Plus (effective 2025-01-01)
On Plus, Cushion covers debit card purchases up to $50.00 below zero, with no fee.

## Turning it on

Go to Profile, then Cushion. You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days. If you stop meeting that, Cushion pauses until you do again.

## Example

If your balance is low and you buy groceries that cost more than you have, Cushion covers the difference as long as the total below zero stays within $50.00. A purchase that would take you past $50.00 below zero is declined.
